dialogues.speaker: Dahlia
dialogues.text: Sorry to keep you all waiting. Would you like to go to confession as well, Miss Barbara? I believe the Cardinal will be working at the Cathedral for some time yet.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Oh, I—I, uh... I'll be fine! My worries are quite small. Nothing worth bothering the Cardinal about.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: A—Anyway, I'm off. My sister's waiting back home... I should be helping her cook.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: #See you, {NICKNAME}, Paimon, Dahlia. I'll invite you all over to listen to the hymn once it's complete.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, that's kinda weird... Isn't the Cardinal her dad? Why does she refer to him by his title?

dialogues.speaker: Dahlia
dialogues.text: Well, we are standing in front of the Favonius Cathedral right now. Perhaps Miss Barbara believes that her identity as "Deaconess" takes precedence in this sacred place.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And what does Cardinal Seamus think?

dialogues.speaker: Dahlia
dialogues.text: If you were to go in and ask him right now, you'd likely get a similar answer.

dialogues.speaker: Dahlia
dialogues.text: But in the world outside? Well... I suppose all we can do is "let the wind lead," and trust the Anemo Archon to help us out.
